title: Debug with Codex

body.text: When you hit a bug, give Codex the
— it traces the code, finds the root cause, and proposes a fix with an explanation of why it broke.

example: "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map') on the /orders page, happens when a user has no orders yet — find the cause and fix it"

title: Fix the root cause, not the symptom

body.text: explain the root cause before proposing a fix
— and have it add a test that catches this bug, so it doesn't come back in the future.

example: "First explain why orders can be undefined, then fix the root cause and add a test case for a user with no orders"

question: What info helps the AI find a bug fastest?

options.text: The error message and steps to reproduce
The name of the person who wrote the code
The date the code was written

question: Why ask for the root cause before accepting a fix?

options.text: To fix the actual cause, not just mask the symptom
It's unnecessary, just fixing is enough

question: After fixing a bug, what should you add to keep it from returning?

options.text: A test that catches this bug
Delete that part of the code

question: What should debugging with Codex focus on?

options.text: Fixing the root cause of the problem, not masking the symptom

question: What does fixing the root cause mean?

options.text: Finding and fixing the true cause of the bug
